extDescription.message: Auto-grow text boxes as you type, pop out into a full-page editor, and restore drafts after a reload. Nothing leaves your device.

onbTitle.message: Text boxes that grow with you · BoxGrow

onb1H1.message: You write in boxes built for one line.

onb1Lede.message: Comment forms, support tickets, email composers. The box stays small while your text gets long, and one wrong click or reload can wipe out a paragraph.

onb1Pt.message: BoxGrow turns that around. The box grows as you type, Alt + Enter opens a full-screen editor, and every field keeps a draft on this device.
onb1Pt.description: Onboarding step 1 supporting paragraph. Honest feature summary only.

onb2H1.message: The box fits your text, not the other way around.

onb2Lede.message: Focus any text box and it grows as you type, up to 80% of the window height. Press Alt + Enter and a calm full-screen editor opens with your text. Save, and the text lands back in the page.
onb2Lede.description: Onboarding step 2 lede. 80% is the real auto-grow clamp; Alt + Enter is the real default hotkey.

mockFill1.message: It grows to fit every line

mockFill3.message: The text lands back in the field

onb2Cap.message: One extension for every text box
onb2Cap.description: Onboarding step 2 caption above the feature tags.

onb3H1.message: Save your first draft before you leave.

onb3Lede.message: Type anything into the practice box and press save. It goes into the same local storage your field drafts use. On real pages, drafts save themselves as you type.

onb3Pt.message: No account and no sign-up. Everything stays on this device, and you can turn drafts off any time in Options.

onb3Label2.description: Onboarding step 3 second practice input label.

onb3Ph2.description: Onboarding step 3 second practice input placeholder.

onbSavedOk.message: Saved on this device. Drafts on real pages work the same way.

onb4H1.message: Your words never leave your device.

onb4Lede.message: BoxGrow makes no network calls except when you activate a license key. No analytics, no sync server, no account. Drafts live in local browser storage.
onb4Lede.description: Onboarding step 4 lede. True by architecture: zero network, storage.local only.

onb4Stat1.description: Onboarding step 4 stat caption under MV3.

onb4Pt.message: BoxGrow is one piece of a bigger idea: an honest layer for the whole browser, one tool at a time. No tracking, no data resale, no SEO spam.

onb4Trust1P.message: Drafts and settings live in local browser storage. No account, no sync server, nothing sent anywhere.

onb4Trust2H.message: One person, building in the open

onb4Trust2P.message: Not a faceless company. A developer who ships in public, uses these tools daily, and answers you directly at

onb5H1.message: Free stays useful. Pro remembers more.

onb5Lede.message: Auto-grow and the pop-out editor are free forever. One payment of ninety-nine dollars unlocks deeper undo, a longer draft history, automatic restore, and a custom hotkey.
onb5Lede.description: Onboarding step 5 lede. Matches the locked value ladder.

onb6H1.message: Focus a box and start typing. That is the whole thing.

onb6Lede.message: No setup left. The box grows, Alt + Enter opens the editor, and drafts keep themselves. Here are the keys worth remembering.

onb6SignBody.message: I build these tools on my own, in the open. If something breaks, write to me and I answer. If you go Pro, your ninety-nine dollars funds the next honest tool, and your notes shape what it becomes.
